[BEGIN]
module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic enable,
    input  logic S,
    input  logic A,
    input  logic B,
    input  logic C,
    output logic Z
);
    logic [7:0] Q;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (enable) begin
            Q <= {Q[6:0], S};
        end
    end

    assign Z = Q[{A, B, C}];
endmodule
[DONE]
